notes: Printed names: 'W. UNIVERSITY AV.', 'W. DANIELS', 'W. CHARLTON', 'SCIOTO', 'ANDY' (north of Daniels marked '(NOT OPEN)'; south of Daniels the 'DEEP HOLLOW' runs down it), 'JEFFERSON AV.', 'FALKE', 'VINE'; suffix-less names written with 'Street'. Scioto lies on the binding at the left edge: only its east kerb (x~330-347) is on the paper and the centre (~150-165) is just inside the paper edge; these three Scioto crossings are the same ones picked on 263 (5510,3902 / 5500,6732) and 266. Falke is 40 ft between University and Daniels and 30 ft south of Daniels (west kerb nearly aligned, centre shifts ~40 px; the Daniels point is the mean). North of University Falke is a different 60 ft leg slanting NNW (only its two kerb stubs show at the top, x~4490-4550 and ~4845-4900); it meets University ~340 px east of the south leg, so it is recorded as a separate T 'Falke Street (north of University)' (centre extrapolated from the kerb stubs to University's centreline). Vine is 90 ft and slants slightly; the area east of Vine is 'See Volume Four', with openings opposite University, Daniels and Charlton, so those are recorded as crossings. A 'FOOT BRIDGE' is drawn inside Daniels between Scioto and Jefferson (not a street). University, Daniels and Charlton continue west onto 263/261/262; Andy, Jefferson, Falke and Vine continue south onto 262 and north onto 266.
